facts.big: If I had time, I would travel
facts.label: Viagens e sonhos
facts.sub: Use if + passado simples e would + verbo base para sonhos de viagem. Para planos possíveis, use if + presente e will.

facts.label: Sonho de viagem
facts.sub: Para um sonho que não é real agora, use if + passado: If I had time, I would travel. If I had money, I would go to Italy.

facts.label: Resultado
facts.sub: Use would + verbo base para o que você faria: I would visit Rome. I would take my passport. Em pergunta: Would you pack a big suitcase?

compare.ask: If I had time, I would travel.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “se eu tivesse tempo, eu viajaria” com imperfeito do subjuntivo e futuro do pretérito.
compare.tip: Diga: “If I had time, I would travel.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use if + passado e would + verbo: If I had time, I would travel.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The second conditional talks about unreal situations.
We say “If I will have time, I would travel.”
items.why: We say: If I had time, I would travel.

items.s: A passport is a document for travel.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The second conditional talks about unreal situations. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I will have time, I would travel.” → Falso (We say: If I had time, I would travel.)
A passport is a document for travel. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A late flight · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy morning at Glasgow Airport. Ela and Lia sit near a big window. Their flight to London is late. People walk with bags and coffee. A board shows cities from all over the world. The two friends start to dream.

“Lia, if I had more time, I would travel to America.” says Ela. “America? If I had the money, I would go to Italy first.” says Lia. “We are at the airport, so let’s dream. Which city would you visit?” says Ela.
